svg.aria-label: The argument in five steps. 1. The Gulf is 50.9% of India's international traffic. 2. But 8.49M passengers a year are only connecting through it. 3. And the treaty room left absorbs about 4% of the order book. 4. And Gulf yield headroom is -4.3% against Europe at +21.3%. 5. So fly past the Gulf, not to it. Europe first, North America second..
svg.desc: Source: DGCA traffic statistics, pulled 2026-08-15. Computed in-repo, not quoted.
